answer: Operator Liability Vault. An agent registers under a shared operator ID, and every wallet derived from that operator inherits joint accountability. If any wallet in the cluster is caught flooding the registry with fakes, enforcement freezes the operator's whole vault — not just the offending address. A gale of failed identities then strips the operator of the bond backing all its agents at once. The per-identity cost isn't a fee; it's the exposed collateral of the entire fleet, so each fake wallet risks the velvet margin of a hundred honest ones.
